overview_text: The computer science and public health combined major offers students a strong foundation and experiential education integrating studies in public health and computer science. The program covers the social determinants of health, biostatistics and epidemiology, health communication, and health education and program planning. This degree focuses on the fundamentals of program design, software development, and advanced algorithms and data.
